# spacelift_ai_integrations (Data Source)

`spacelift_ai_integrations` represents a list of all the AI integrations in the Spacelift account visible to the API user, including the read-only ones provided by Spacelift.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spacelift_ai_integrations" "all" {}

# Only the integrations carrying every one of these labels.
data "spacelift_ai_integrations" "tagged" {
  labels = ["ai"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (Set of String) required labels to match

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `integrations` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>

- `models` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `provider_integration_id` (String)
- `space_id` (String)
